name: Establish Sacred Grove
description:
Recruit a Völur that will establish a Sacred Grove on a Relic or Sacred Site which increases the armor of nearby units by +1 and Berserkers are automatically recruited over time.
The Sacred Grove health regenerates at 5/s if no enemies are nearby for at least 30 seconds.
Limited to 3 Sacred Groves.
descriptionCN:
招募一名维勒尔，将在圣物或圣地上建立神圣树林，使附近单位护甲提升 +1，并自动招募狂战士。
若附近至少 30 秒内无敌军，神圣树林每秒恢复生命值 5。
最多可拥有 3 个神圣树林。
